arsenale.name: Arsenal
arsenale.desc: Unlocks the units and upgrades them: every level opens new cards in the unit rows. The crates arrive sealed: nobody asks where from.
levels: Weapons: Scouts, first Infantry upgrade
Weapons: Artillery, Infantry and Scout upgrades
Weapons: Armour, Engineers, Ammunition, new upgrades
Weapons: Gunboat, Armour plating, new upgrades
Weapons: Air reconnaissance, Bombardment, new upgrades
Weapons: unique unit of your power, units +25% health

comando.name: Command Center
comando.desc: The headquarters. Its level unlocks everything: the other rooms can never be more than one level above it.
levels: Field reports: events during campaigns, troops +4%
Intercepts: fragments about the mystery of the Fall, troops +8%
Alert network: +30 s for every campaign, troops +12%
Coordination: one more unit on the field, troops +16%
Supreme command: abilities -25% cooldown, troops +20%

deposito.name: Depot
deposito.desc: Resource capacity (3,000 per type at the start: anything above is lost) and how much of the spoils you keep if a campaign goes badly.
levels: Capacity 10,000, if eliminated you lose only 40%, stake insured at 10%
Capacity 24,000, if eliminated you lose only 25%, stake insured at 20%
Capacity 60,000, orderly retreat: +10% on the spoils, stake insured at 30%

spedizione.name: Extraction Teams
spedizione.desc: Timed expeditions into the lands of the Fall. They come back with food, metal and fuel.

laboratorio.name: Laboratory
laboratorio.desc: Studies the new technology: research that changes campaigns and, little by little, the mystery of the Fall.
levels: Basic research
Advanced research
Project Fall: the final research

radar.name: Radar Room
radar.desc: Listens and records. Keeps the campaign log and extends your sight on the field.
levels: Campaign log, sight +1, maps of the area
Sight +2, wider maps around the starting point
Sight +3, almost the whole region already known

ricognizione.name: Air reconnaissance
ricognizione.desc: A plane flies over the tapped area: reveals enemies and territory for 15 s.

bombardamento.name: Bombardment
bombardamento.desc: Strikes the tapped area: enemy tiles turn neutral, units lose health.
